key_idea: Integrating out the multiscale decomposition of the Gaussian Free Field scale by scale, absorbing the effect of long-range correlations into a Bernoulli percolation parameter via an Aizenman-Grimmett-style differential inequality.
reason: The proof elegantly implements a rigorous renormalization group step using essential enhancements from percolation theory. By tracking the continuous interpolation of the field's scales through short, conceptual probabilistic bounds, it avoids the heavy analytic bookkeeping typically needed for long-range correlated fields.
recognized: Existence of phase transition for percolation using the Gaussian Free Field (Duminil-Copin, Goswami, Raoufi, Severo, Yadin, 2020)
